verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents a public REST API for driving local models from apps and scripts. This includes a native versioned v1 API at /api/v1/*, OpenAI-like endpoints, an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint, and a dedicated API changelog. Community users corroborate using its OpenAI-compatible server and headless flow from real tools. missing for 10: no published deprecation/sunset policy, and the pack lacks detailed endpoint-level reference showing app-management operations (beyond inference and model loading) are exposed via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: LM Studio provides a REST API that you can use to interact with your local models from your own apps and scripts.
With LM Studio 0.4.0, we have officially released our native v1 REST API at `/api/v1/*` endpoints and recommend using it.
Serve local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network
the OpenAI server makes it really easy to spin up a server and test
